title: One More Step
game_overview: A minimalist 3D puzzle game where every tile you leave deactivates. Plan your path carefully to reach the exit within the target moves.
winning_condition: Navigate to the exit tile on each level without trapping yourself or running out of valid moves.
losing_condition: The player becomes trapped with no valid adjacent active tiles remaining before reaching the exit.

controls.input: W / Up Arrow / Swipe Up / Touch D-Pad Up
S / Down Arrow / Swipe Down / Touch D-Pad Down
A / Left Arrow / Swipe Left / Touch D-Pad Left
D / Right Arrow / Swipe Right / Touch D-Pad Right

controls.action: Instantly reset the current puzzle level to its starting state.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Spatial Precision: Every step permanently changes the level topology, requiring deliberate forethought. 2. Minimalist Elegance: Midnight background with glowing cyan/amber glass tiles and crisp tactile feedback. 3. Zero Friction: Instant one-click or single-key restarts and fluid step animations.
sections.summary: Pillars prioritizing spatial strategy, clean minimalism, and instant feedback.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: The player spawns on a starting tile of a compact 3D grid. With every move in the 4 cardinal directions, the player glides to an adjacent active tile, and the vacated tile sinks and deactivates with a luminous fade. Reaching the glowing exit tile finishes the level, evaluating move efficiency against the Gold Target. Players can instantly retry or proceed to the next handcrafted puzzle.
sections.summary: Inspect the grid, plan a route, step through tiles, and reach the exit.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Dynamic Tile Deactivation: Stepping off an active tile transforms it into a sunken inactive void that cannot be revisited. 2. Solid Obstacles: Elevated monolith walls block movement and route planning. 3. Target Move Rating: Gold rating awarded for finishing at or under target moves, and silver for standard completion. 4. Instant Reset & Clean Controls: Microsecond resets allow players to iterate freely without animation delays.
sections.summary: Tile deactivation, impassable walls, target move ratings, and undo/restart.

sections.title: 3D Camera & Movement Alignment
sections.content: 3D Coordinate System: Three.js standard coordinates (+Y is Up, +X is Right/East, -Z is North, +Z is South). Camera Perspective: Elevated angled isometric view (FOV 45, tilted ~55 degrees downward) centered dynamically on the current level grid dimensions. Movement Dynamics: Smooth cubic bezier lerp translation between grid nodes with micro squash-and-stretch and downward ripple on the departing tile.
sections.summary: Isometric tilted top-down camera with crisp grid-snapping step animations.

sections.title: 3D Scene Hierarchy & Lighting
sections.content: 3D Scene Separation: Deep midnight backdrop (#0a0d14) with subtle floating ambient dust embers. Interactive gameplay grid features frosted glass tiles, glowing cyan player prism, emerald exit beacon, and obsidian monolith walls. High-intensity 3-point lighting setup with soft ambient and directed key lights for crisp chamfer highlights.
sections.summary: Deep midnight atmospheric space with luminous neon accent glow and glass shaders.

sections.title: Level Progression
sections.content: Level 1 (The First Step): Introduces stepping and tile deactivation in a simple straight/corner path. Level 2 (The Fork): Introduces a single detour where a wrong turn isolates the exit. Level 3 (The Island Bridge): Introduces choke points and wall-bounded corridors. Level 4 (The Spiral Maze): Requires weaving through interlocking loops where visiting in wrong order cuts off passage. Level 5 (The Grand Labyrinth): A master test of spatial planning with dual pathways and tight gold target move count.
sections.summary: Five handcrafted, progressively challenging spatial puzzles.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Subtle hover/direction indicator pulses in the intended direction. State Change Juice: As the player departs, the tile drops slightly along Y with an emissive dissipation ripple and soft mechanical click. Impact Juice: Reaching the exit triggers an expanding light pillar, harmonic chime, and gold star burst.
sections.summary: Crisp multi-sensory feedback for steps, tile sinking, and victory.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Render on-screen virtual directional buttons conditionally when mobile is detected via useIsMobile(). Buttons feature touch-none, pointer-events-auto, and handle onPointerDown, onPointerUp, onPointerLeave, and onPointerCancel to prevent sticky movement. Swipe gestures on the 3D canvas also trigger instant steps.
sections.summary: Responsive on-screen D-Pad and swipe gestures for mobile gameplay.
